summary: DARPA CADETS scoring uses derived ThreaTrace UUID node mapping expanded to event labels by node touch.
event_positive_rule: An event is labelled positive when its event UUID, subject UUID, predicate object UUID, or predicate object2 UUID intersects the derived ThreaTrace UUID set.
methodological_status: defensible only as derived node-touch event scoring; it must not be described as official DARPA event ground truth.
